title: Exact-functor transport of an Ext class and its derived morphism
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories with chosen derived categories and small Ext groups. Let F:C→D be additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits. For objects M,Q of C, n≥0 and x∈Extⁿ(M,Q), let s be the canonical isomorphism (-)[0] ⋙ D(F) ≅ F ⋙ (-)[0]. Then the derived morphism of the induced class F_*(x) is s_M⁻¹ followed by the shifted morphism D(F)(x.hom) (including the canonical shift comparison) followed by s_Q[n]. This applies in particular to exact etale inverse image.

mathlib_searches.query: Mapping an Ext class by an exact functor corresponds to its derived morphism through the canonical single-object comparison
The derived functor of an exact functor sends the derived morphism representing an Ext class to the morphism of the mapped Ext class

lemma Abelian.Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{t'} D]
    [HasExt.{w} C] [HasExt.{w'} D] {X Y : C} {n : ℕ} (e : Ext X Y n) :
    (e.mapExactFunctor F).hom =
      (F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).inv.app X ≫ e.hom.map F.mapDerivedCategory ≫
        ((F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app Y)⟦(n : ℤ)⟧'
